items.title: Dave Liebman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Hubert is the flute player of all time, but as far as jazz goes, Lew – Lew great, but Joe for the depth of ideas.

ctx.x: Neither of them have the command of harmony.
Hubert is the flute player of all time, but as far as jazz goes, Lew – Lew great, but Joe for the depth of ideas.
He took all of Coltrane’s shit, harmonically, and brought it into flute . . .
